title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
author: Lewis et al. (NeurIPS 2020)
why: The paper that named RAG: a dense retriever over Wikipedia passages combined with a generator, and why retrieval makes knowledge updatable.

title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion outperforms Condorcet and individual Rank Learning Methods
author: Cormack, Clarke and Büttcher (SIGIR 2009)
why: A two-page paper with the 1 / (k + rank) formula behind most hybrid search fusion.

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
author: Liu et al. (2023)

title: Introducing Contextual Retrieval
author: Anthropic
why: A practical walk-through of chunk context, hybrid BM25 plus embeddings, and reranking in one pipeline.
